title: Viewing the Industry Peer Comparison Report

blocks.text: The Industry Peer Comparison Report compares your organization's performance and effectiveness for the preceding month to that of both peer organizations and all companies using the cloud service. By accessing Industry Peer Comparison features, you provide Zscaler the right to compare your organization's performance and effectiveness of using Zscaler products for the preceding month to other peer organizations and all companies using our cloud service. Peers are chosen based on business vertical, geographic region, and business size.
To view the Peer Comparison Report, from the navigation menu, go to Analytics > Reports > Industry Peer Comparison.
